notes: Easy Building: Instant build speed is faster, Mirror now flips slabs, torches, observers and amethyst and works with Array and Radial, and Radial turns stairs and logs with each slice.
Easy Building: a shape bigger than your block limit shows the exceeds-limit warning and is refused, a far-off anchor is cleared, and Undo refunds the right number of items.
Easy Building: the Building Book no longer needs left-click shortcuts; open Modifiers and the Block Palette from the Mode Menu or their commands.
Expeditions: a Nightmare Sigil is no longer lost when the server restarts before your party goes in; it comes back to the leader in a parcel.
Townsfolk: gossip about a player is no longer repeated or told back to that player, and Undo for moving townsfolk remembers the right spots.

admin_bp.notes: Server size waits a fixed 5 seconds for every setting and is saved as done only when all were applied; the setup checklist waits once more for long answers; the diagnostics screen is tidier. Diagnostics: only the server console or an operator player can send the forget request, and wrapped callbacks are tracked per event signal.
